title: Teardown of GPay's UPI Lite rollout
scenario: GPay rolled out UPI Lite (offline, ≤₹4000, faster) to 100M users in 90 days, NPCI is pushing hard. Your CEO wants a teardown by Wednesday: what GPay did right, what they're vulnerable to, and the smallest move PhonePe can make in 4 weeks that doesn't look like a copy. He's allergic to ‘we should also do it’ recommendations.
badPrompt: do a teardown of gpay upi lite rollout
badOutput: GPay's UPI Lite is a strong product, fast, offline, low-friction. They scaled to 100M users quickly. PhonePe should consider launching a similar feature with our brand twist to compete. We should focus on user experience and growth.

hints.title: Force a vulnerability search
hints.body: ‘What's GPay vulnerable to, that PhonePe could exploit?’ Teardowns without vulnerabilities become flattery.

hints.title: Ban ‘we should also do it’
hints.body: Add the negative explicitly. Differentiation in payments is hard, the prompt has to force it.

checks.tip: Frame the artifact, a teardown, not a comparison.
Anchor the product, UPI Lite, payments domain.
Anchor the scale, 100M users in 90 days.
Reference the CEO and Wednesday deadline.
Add the negative, no ‘we should also do it’ recommendations.
Lock the time horizon, smallest move in 4 weeks.
Force a vulnerability search, what's GPay weak at.
Demand both, what they did right AND vulnerabilities.
Specify a structured output, did right + vulnerabilities + our move.
Lock the length, 1-pager, otherwise it sprawls.

tipIfLow: Competitive teardowns become flattery without a vulnerability search. The unlock is forcing what's GPay's exposed flank, AND banning ‘we should also do it’. Differentiation in commodity categories like payments doesn't happen unless the prompt requires it.
goldPrompt: Act as a competitive-strategy partner. I'm Nikhil, strategist at PhonePe. GPay rolled UPI Lite (offline, ≤₹4000, faster) to 100M users in 90 days. CEO needs a teardown by Wednesday. Format: (1) What GPay did right — 3 mechanisms, not features, (2) GPay's vulnerable flank — 2 specific weaknesses PhonePe could exploit, (3) Smallest move PhonePe can ship in 4 weeks. Banned: 'we should also do it'-style recommendations. Banned: feature-parity logic. Differentiation only. Cap at 350 words.
